## Why this change?

Problem/question, approach and related issue (if any). Small focused fixes and draft experiments are welcome.

## Verification

Exact commands/results, relevant screenshots/fixtures, and checks not run. Do not claim tests or live deployment you did not perform.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I understand the diff and kept it focused; existing contracts/content remain compatible or changes are explained.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant regression tests and documentation.
- [ ] I checked security/privacy, keyboard/accessibility, themes and languages where affected.
- [ ] I preserved third-party licenses/provenance and included no secrets or private data.
- [ ] I did not deploy, modify production data or change routes/storage identities as part of this PR.

Vibe Coding and AI-assisted contributions are welcome. Use any tool; the result must be understandable and verifiable. Tool/prompt disclosure is optional.
